title: Spidey Super Stories: The Electric Company - Peter Pan Records LP
fulltitle: Spidey Super Stories: The Electric Company - Peter Pan Records LP
description:
The 1977 Peter Pan Records LP The Electric Company: Spidey Super Stories, Sides A and B. Includes these Spider-Man stories:

A1 - The Purple Pirates And Evil McWeevil
A2 - Spidey Meets The Jester
A3 - Spidey Vs. Mister Measles
A4  - Spider-Man Is Born!
A5 - Spidey And The Queen Bee
B1 - Deadly Is The Doctor Called Doom
B2 - Spidey And The Mole Man
B3 - Spidey And The Sandman
